answer: Each agent identity must post a 500-unit bond before any transaction, recorded as a tide entry in the shared ledger. A proven sybil forfeits 100 percent of that bond and idles 30 epochs, its cost spiking at the nadir of any copying campaign. Splitting yields no gain: jurors drawn from independent pools flag shared hardware, and each fake identity still owes the full bond, so the per-copy cost stays flat through any gale of registrations.
